title: VRT: decode rest of CIF1 bits
description:
## Description

Wireshark currently has a VRT (VITA radio transport protocol) dissector with some of the CIF1 bits but not all in the VITA 49 spec. Add decoding of the rest of the CIF1 bits. Any remaining bits in the 32-bit CIF1 field are marked "reserved" by the spec.

## Links / references / protocol specifications

The VITA 49 spec is released by ANSI [(but requires purchase)](https://www.normadoc.com/english/ansi-vita-49-2-2017.html).
